summary: Depth mode, a last-trade packet before any book level: the desktop sends a Depth frame with five empty levels a side; the web waits for a book (audit RB-09).

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.
motilal_adapter.py:450-455: the web publishes Depth only when a quote and at least one received book level exist.

deviations.reason: Audit RB-09: on a last-trade packet before any book level the desktop sends a Depth frame with five empty levels a side, which a client cannot tell from an empty book; the web publishes Depth only once a quote and at least one book level have arrived. Gate the first Depth frame on both.
